notes: Child runtimes owned by a registered Shared Environment autoload are not production autoloads themselves and therefore require an explicit lifecycle registry and dedicated fail-closed gate.
Fonsny must restore owned visibility before detaching and freeing only its exact replacement root.
The dedicated owned-child lifecycle rail must also remain wired into the central Shared Environment lifecycle gate.
This contract does not authorize geometry, material, transform, collision, camera, FOV, threshold, or source-placement changes.
